daily.today_energy: Your vibe is giving introspective innovator energy. The cosmos is nudging you to slow down and tune into what actually matters beneath all the noise. Trust the quiet moments.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, there's an opening for deeper conversation happening today. Single? Someone's noticing your authentic self. Don't dim your light trying to fit a mold.
daily.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different right now. This is your moment to pitch that thing you've been sitting on. The universe has your back on this one.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding—maybe that's a walk, some water, or just being present. Listening to what you need (not what you think you should do) is the real win today.

weekly.overview: This week kicks off with the Moon in Pisces softening your edges, but things get real when it shifts to Taurus midweek—time to ground your brilliant ideas into actual plans. The Sun's square to Mars (Nov 21) brings friction that pushes you to act instead of overthink, while Venus sextile Jupiter smooths things socially. Best Day: Nov 23. Watch-Out Day: Nov 21.
weekly.love: Early week feels dreamy and introspective; use it to get clear on what you actually want, not what sounds cool. Midweek, the Taurus Moon demands authenticity—fake it and they'll know. By Friday, Venus sextile Jupiter opens doors for genuine connection and those spontaneous conversations that lead somewhere real.
weekly.career: The Sun square Mars energy on Tuesday is your signal to stop debating and start deciding. This isn't the week for consensus-building; it's for bold moves and clear boundaries. Mercury in Scorpio keeps things sharp and strategic. By week's end, momentum builds as obstacles soften—nail down that proposal or pitch.
weekly.health: Your nervous system needs attention early week—Pisces Moon can make you scattered. Midweek Taurus vibes call for grounding practices: yoga, long walks, solid meals. The Full Moon on Nov 24 peaks your energy, so channel it into movement rather than spinning in your head. Sleep matters more than usual.
